# Browser libraries

Vendored from jsDelivr for reproducible, offline-capable rendering with no build step.

- vendor/d3.min.js: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js
- vendor/topojson-client.min.js: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js
- vendor/scrollama.min.js: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/scrollama@3.2.0/build/scrollama.min.js
- vendor/d3-LICENSE: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/LICENSE
- vendor/topojson-client-LICENSE: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/LICENSE
- vendor/scrollama-LICENSE: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/scrollama@3.2.0/LICENSE

Boundary files in data/: world-atlas 2.0.2 (Natural Earth), us-atlas 3.0.1 (US Census). Source links are on the webpage.
